mapper.sql: file.sys10_file_id AS file_id, file.sys10_parent_id AS parent_id, file.sys10_file_nm AS file_nm, file.sys10_reg_date AS reg_date, file.sys10_server_path AS server_path, file.sys10_size AS size, file.sys10_note AS note, file.sys10_file_ext AS file_ext, file.sys10_file_yn AS file_yn, file.sys10_title_yn AS title_yn, file.sys10_seq AS seq
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( SELECT * FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_file_id = #{fileId} UNION SELECT sys10_file.* FROM sys11_relate_file INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_file_id = sys11_file_id WHERE sys11_file_id = #{fileId} ) AS file

SELECT FROM ( SELECT * FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{parentId} UNION SELECT sys10_file.* FROM sys11_relate_file INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_file_id = sys11_file_id WHERE sys11_parent_id = #{parentId} ) AS file ORDER BY LPAD(COALESCE(file.sys10_seq, '99999'), 5, '0'), COALESCE(file.sys10_title_yn, 'false') DESC, file.sys10_file_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu"
SELECT FROM sys10_file file WHERE file.sys10_parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY file.sys10_reg_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys10_file (sys10_file_id, sys10_parent_id, sys10_file_nm, sys10_reg_date, sys10_server_path, sys10_size, sys10_note, sys10_file_ext, sys10_file_yn, sys10_admin_yn, sys10_law_type, sys10_print_yn, sys10_ext_yn) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{parentId}, #{fileNm}, f_sysdate(), #{serverPath}, #{size}, '', #{fileExt}, #{fileYn}, NULL, NULL, 'true', 'false')
